title: autospec protocol execution v1
description: One attempt to run a task on one worker, with the evidence that the agent actually started. Built on the envelope in autospec-protocol-envelope.v1.schema.json; only the keyword subset in docs/contracts/autospec-protocol-v1.md section Schema subset is used.

agent_rc.description: Agent process exit code, when it has exited.

start_evidence.description: Evidence that the agent started. An exit code 0 with no session record or zero assistant turns is AGENT-NEVER-STARTED, a failure. Members are present only when observed.

status.description: Terminal status as the fleet records it (RunStatus) plus SIGNALLED.

protocol_version.title: protocol version
protocol_version.description: Protocol major version this message was produced under. It must equal the version both peers negotiated (highest common supported_versions entry); otherwise the reader fails closed with PROTOCOL_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.

idempotency_key.title: idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Producer-chosen key, unique within one mission_id. Redelivery of the same key with the same sequence is a duplicate and must not repeat any effect. Reusing a key at a different sequence is an error.

mission_id.title: mission identifier
mission_id.description: Identifier of the mission whose ordered stream this message belongs to. Sequence numbers are scoped to this value.

sequence.title: per-mission sequence
sequence.description: Monotonic position in the mission stream. It starts at 1 and advances by exactly 1 with no gaps, as the evaluation journal does.

required_extensions.title: required extensions
required_extensions.description: Names of extensions keys the reader must understand. A name the reader does not understand makes the whole message UNKNOWN_REQUIRED_FIELD and no part of it is applied. Always present; an empty array means none.

extensions.title: optional extensions
extensions.description: The only place optional unknown data may live. Keys not named in required_extensions are ignored by a reader that does not understand them; they never carry data a reader must act on.
